title: Newton's Second Law For Rotation
text: Use Newton's second law for rotation, $$\tau=I\alpha, $$ where $$\tau=fr$$ is the torque due to friction and $$\alpha$$ is the angular acceleration. The grindstone's moment of inertia is $$I=\tfrac12mr**2.$$ Friction slows the stone down, so $$\alpha$$ is negative.

title: Calculate the Moment of Inertia of the Grindstone
text: What is the moment of inertia $$I$$ of the grindstone about its center? Give it to one decimal place (in $$\text{kg}\cdot\text{m}**2)$$.
